We need to fix compilation errors.

Issues:

- Mockito imports missing: we can remove Mockito usage or replace with JUnit's built-in? The test uses @Mock annotations, but we can avoid needing Mockito by not using mocks. Actually the test only uses @Mock for fields: JsonSchema mockParentSchema; ValidatorTypeCode mockValidatorType; ValidationContext mockValidationContext; Set<ValidationMessage> expectedSet; Set<ValidationMessage> dummyReturnSet; They are not used in test (except dummyReturnSet is reinitialized in setup, not mock). So we can remove Mockito imports and annotations, and just use regular fields without @Mock.

- Also need to adjust BaseJsonValidator constructor call: actual constructors are (String, JsonNode, JsonSchema, ValidatorTypeCode, ValidationContext) and (String, JsonNode, JsonSchema, ValidatorTypeCode, ValidationContext, boolean). The test passes an extra Set argument. So we need to remove that extra argument. The comment says BaseJsonValidator expects an additional Set argument, but actual code does not. So modify TestValidator constructor to call appropriate super without extra set.

- Also need to adjust fields: suppressSubSchemaRetrieval boolean parameter is passed but order? In constructors: there is a version with boolean as last param (6 args). In test they pass (String, JsonNode, JsonSchema, ValidatorTypeCode, ValidationContext, boolean, Set). So we need to match the 6-arg version: super(schemaPath, schemaNode, parentSchema, validatorType, validationContext, suppressSubSchemaRetrieval); and we won't pass set.

- Also need to import missing classes: ExecutionContext, ValidationMessage, ValidationContext, ValidatorTypeCode, JsonSchema, BaseJsonValidator. Already imported package same. No need for Mockito imports.

- Remove unused imports: org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension, org.mockito.*, org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith; Also remove @ExtendWith annotation.

- Also need to adjust @Mock fields: just declare them as regular fields, maybe not needed at all; we can remove them.

- In setupBeforeEach, dummyReturnSet = new HashSet<>(); but dummyReturnSet field previously annotated @Mock; we can keep as Set<ValidationMessage> dummyReturnSet; and instantiate.

- The test uses Assertions from JUnit. Already imported org.junit.jupiter.api.* includes Assertions.

- Need to import Set, HashSet, Collections, etc.

- Ensure we have imports for ExecutionContext, ValidationMessage, ValidationContext, ValidatorTypeCode, JsonSchema, BaseJsonValidator. They are in same package com.networknt.schema, so no import needed.

- Also need to import org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest, MethodSource, Arguments, Stream.

- The test uses setValidatorSchemaNode via reflection; BaseJsonValidator has protected field schemaNode.

- Ensure TestValidator overrides protected fetchSubSchemaNode method signature matches BaseJsonValidator's method: It is protected JsonSchema fetchSubSchemaNode(ValidationContext vc). Already used.

- Ensure BaseJsonValidator.validate(ExecutionContext, JsonNode) exists and calls 4-arg version with rootNode = node and at = atRoot(). The test expects that.

- The test also expects that when schemaNode is null, validator.validate returns empty set. That logic exists in BaseJsonValidator.validate maybe.

- Ensure imports for java.lang.reflect.Field.

Now produce corrected code.
